'''Vreego''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He worked for the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ilb Toranda]] and during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Toranda sent Vreego and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Krael]] to purchase some illegal weapons from a Human woman in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
